request: Repair the customer rental flow and mobile checkout shown in the three iPhone screenshots.
sourceFixes: Separate pickup/return dates from real available shop times; invalid saved 11 PM times require an explicit correction.
Public shop slots work when date-first catalogue browsing is disabled. Rental-disabled shops, lead time, closed dates and capacity checks remain enforced.
Return slot search supports legitimate return dates beyond the pickup booking advance window.
Guest rental selections survive the real OTP account-provider remount; quantities and boutique/account separation remain protected.
Compact item photo, estimated rent/security and final server total are visible. Rent remains charged only for the selected use days.
Date, quantity, payment-plan and delivery-address edits require a fresh quote/review.
Delivery/collection address appears in the final review. Simplified checkout explicitly uses the same address for collection.
Help and analytics privacy controls appear inline on rental shopping pages and rental product detail, clear of booking actions.
Disabled online payments have an explicit explanation; enabled pay-at-pickup bookings still work.
Rental request/upload limits return a typed JSON message with retry guidance; existing limits remain unchanged.

frontend.scope: Affected customer rental, bag adoption, payment recovery, details/calendar and help/privacy suites. Not a new whole-project total.

backend.scope: Rental shopping/journey/lifecycle/pricing/details API and service suites; isolated local MongoDB replica sets and mocked provider/licence prerequisites.

browser.engine: Installed headless Chrome; touch viewport at 390px
browser.api: Real local Express app and isolated local MongoDB replica set, fresh server per viewport.
verified: Rental catalogue search, sorting and rent filters
Sale stock zero still allows rental selection
Product detail to rental bag and quantity controls
Actual shop slot API and authoritative quote
Guest OTP login and same bag/dates restored at 390px
Enabled pay-at-pickup confirmation creates exactly one booking
One use day costs INR 1000 rent plus INR 500 security; pickup/return days add no rent
Customer cancellation request reaches the backend and staff approval is reflected in the customer view
No page errors or horizontal overflow
browser.onlineGateway: Covered by mocked frontend/backend tests. No real provider checkout/capture/refund.

liveReadOnlyFindings.scope: Public configuration, catalogue, slots and read-only quote. No authenticated commerce mutation.
liveReadOnlyFindings.publicQuote: A selected occasion day with pickup/return around it quoted INR 1000 rent, INR 500 security and zero due now under the enabled PICKUP plan.

deployment.required: Redeploy both frontend and canonical backend/ to apply these changes.
prerequisites: Enable/configure the online provider and intended payment methods to offer advance/full online payment.
Verify real OTP delivery and a controlled hosted rental booking/payment/return/refund with authorized staff.
Test the updated date/time controls on the actual iPhone Safari device.
deployment.note: Local regressions do not certify production licence validity, hosted provider delivery, real charges/refunds or physical item readiness.
